papers.title: Strategic Timing Games in Ethereum: An Empirical Study and Mitigation
papers.abstractOneWord: 实证并缓解以太坊上的策略性时序博弈，无 LLM，对象是 Ethereum 出块 / MEV 时序。
papers.abstract: 以太坊提议者可以通过故意延迟出块来打时序博弈，从而争夺更多可提取价值，同时仍争取让区块进入规范链。本文对以太坊中的策略性时序博弈做实证研究，并讨论相应缓解措施。公开早访问页未提供英文摘要，因此这里只根据已核验的标题与 TDSC 记录概述问题与贡献类型，不补充未公开的实验数字。

papers.title: ORCAGen: Orchestrating Context-Aware Malware Deception with RAG-Guided Generative AI
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 RAG 引导的大模型离线生成并验证恶意软件欺骗剧本，对象是键盘记录、窃密与勒索软件。
papers.abstract: 恶意软件防护通常会尽快隔离或清除可疑程序。这有利于遏制，却也可能错过观察攻击者行为并部署针对性反制的机会。ORCAGen 换了一种做法：用生成式 AI 离线构建面向特定恶意软件的欺骗剧本，先验证再部署，运行时只执行已验证逻辑。它把检索增强生成（RAG）与结构化提示工程结合起来，同时生成概念验证（PoC）恶意软件和对应的欺骗编排代码。由恶意软件流程与主动防御策略组成的知识库为生成提供依据，帮助大模型产出针对具体威胁、可执行的欺骗逻辑，而不是泛化或幻觉输出。生成的 PoC 恶意软件提供安全、可复现的测试方式，用来检查某条欺骗策略能否在加入运行时剧本之前干扰、重定向或抑制目标行为。作者在 GPT-4o、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Qwen3-Coder 与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 上评估执行成功率、幻觉率、精炼开销、欺骗效果与运行时开销，覆盖合成场景以及 150 个真实键盘记录器、信息窃取器和勒索软件样本。评估中 GPT-5.5 所需精炼最少且未观察到幻觉 API，Gemini 3.5 Flash 的响应时间与运行时开销最低。结果表明，RAG 引导的结构化提示可以支撑可扩展地构建恶意软件专用欺骗剧本，并在运行时保持轻量和确定性。
papers.abstractEn: Malware defenses often remove or isolate suspicious programs as quickly as possible. While effective for containment, this approach can also waste an opportunity to observe attacker behavior and deploy targeted countermeasures. ORCAGen takes a different approach: it uses GenAI to build malware-specific deception playbooks offline, validates them before deployment, and enforces only the verified logic at runtime. ORCAGen combines Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with structured prompt engineering to generate both proof-of-concept (PoC) malware and corresponding deception orchestration code. A curated knowledge base (KB) of malware procedures and active defense strategies grounds the generation process, helping the LLM produce threat-specific and executable deception logic rather than generic or hallucinated outputs. The generated PoC malware provides a safe and reproducible way to test whether a deception strategy can disrupt, redirect, or suppress targeted malware behavior before the strategy is added to the runtime playbook. We evaluate ORCAGen across GPT-4o, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Qwen3-Coder, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 using execution success, hallucination rate, refinement effort, deception effectiveness, and runtime overhead. The evaluation covers synthesized malware scenarios and 150 real-world malware samples across keyloggers, information stealers, and ransomware. Across the evaluated scenarios, GPT-5.5 required the fewest refinements and produced no observed hallucinated APIs, while Gemini 3.5 Flash achieved the lowest response time and runtime overhead. The results show that RAG-guided structured prompting can support the scalable construction of malware-specific deception playbooks that remain lightweight and deterministic during runtime enforcement.

papers.title: Time-Space Tradeoffs For Probabilistic Proofs
papers.abstractOneWord: 给出 PCP/IOP 在顺序输入模型下的时空权衡，无 LLM，对象是概率证明与 zk 证明系统。
papers.abstract: 许多近期的概率证明构造证明时间很快，但空间复杂度很高，往往远高于被证明计算本身的空间。经验上看，这是因为纠错码——这类构造的关键组件——受限于时空权衡。但证明系统本身是否也存在这类权衡，此前并不清楚。本文为具有直线知识可靠性的概率可检验证明（PCP）及其多轮扩展交互预言证明（IOP）建立时空权衡。结果适用于对输入顺序访问的机器计算，这与纠错码上类似权衡成立的模型相同。作为补充，作者描述了一个面向 R1CS 的 IOP：它避开该权衡，但需要对 R1CS 见证做随机访问。技术上，工作建立并扩展了 Cook 与 Moshkovitz（CCC 2024）关于码的结果。建立权衡的一个关键困难是：已有码结果高度依赖距离，而概率证明没有自然的距离概念。尽管如此，在抗碰撞哈希存在的前提下，作者通过把小空间机器的信息流与证明系统性质仔细关联，建立起时空权衡。
papers.abstractEn: Many recent constructions of probabilistic proofs achieve fast proving times but have high space complexity (much higher than that of the computation being proved). Empirically this arises due to the fact that error-correcting codes, a key ingredient of such constructions, suffer from limiting time-space tradeoffs. It remained open, however, whether such time-space tradeoffs exist for proofs themselves. We establish time-space tradeoffs for probabilistically checkable proofs (PCPs) as well as for their multi-round extension, interactive oracle proofs (IOPs), with straightline knowledge soundness. Our results hold for machine computations that have sequential input access, the same model for which similar tradeoffs hold for error-correcting codes. We complement this result by describing an IOP for R1CS that avoids the tradeoff but requires random access to the R1CS witness. Our techniques build on and extend results for codes of Cook and Moshkovitz (CCC 2024). A key difficulty that we encounter in establishing our tradeoff is that distance of the code plays a key role in prior results, while for probabilistic proofs there is no natural notion of distance. Nevertheless, we show that, assuming the existence of collision-resistant hash functions, we can establish time-space tradeoffs by carefully relating a small-space machine's information flow to the proof system's properties.

papers.title: Note on Extractability of PST Polynomial Commitment Scheme
papers.abstractOneWord: 澄清 PST 多项式承诺可抽取性假设的强度并指出证明缺口，无 LLM，对象是 zk 多项式承诺。
papers.abstract: Belohorec 等人（Crypto 2025）最近证明，著名的 PST 多变量多项式承诺方案在可证伪假设下是黑盒可抽取的。他们证明：略作修改（扩展）的 PST 在假设 ARSDH(n) 下可抽取，而标准 PST 在假设 GARSDH(n) 下可抽取。这两个假设都是新的，且比 Lipmaa 等人（Eurocrypt 2024）为证明单变量 KZG 多项式承诺黑盒可抽取性而提出的原始 ARSDH 假设更专门。一个自然问题是：这些假设是否实际上强于原始 ARSDH。本文给出否定回答：ARSDH(n) 与 GARSDH(n) 都等价于原始 ARSDH 假设。其次，作者指出“标准 PST 在 GARSDH(n) 下可抽取”这一证明中的缺口。
papers.abstractEn: A recent work by Belohorec et al. (Crypto, 2025) shows that the well-known PST multivariate polynomial commitment scheme is black-box extractable under falsifiable assumptions. They show that a minimally modified (extended) PST is extractable under an assumption ARSDH(n), and that the canonical PST is extractable under an assumption GARSDH(n). Both of these assumptions are new and more specialized than the original ARSDH assumption proposed by Lipmaa et al. (Eurocrypt, 2024) to prove black-box extractability of the univariate KZG polynomial commitment. A natural question is whether these assumptions are actually stronger than the original ARSDH assumption. We answer this negatively: we show that both ARSDH(n) and GARSDH(n) are equivalent to the original ARSDH assumption. Secondly, we point out a gap in the proof that canonical PST is extractable under GARSDH(n) assumption.

papers.title: On-Chain Archaeology of Bitcoin Oracles: Evidence of Use under Limited Observability
papers.abstractOneWord: 在有限可观测条件下追溯比特币预言机的链上使用证据，无 LLM，对象是 Bitcoin 预言机与 DLC。
papers.abstract: 在以太坊让“预言机问题”成为常用术语之前，比特币上已经有预言机充当数据源、密钥释放服务、联邦签名方和仲裁者，并在主链上承载真实价值。本研究追溯其使用情况，以及从早期到 2026 年 7 月预言机活动证据如何变化。作者完整普查 Counterparty 博彩（1149 笔投注），分析截至区块 958628 的整条比特币链，并在 8.54 亿行公钥索引中检索 Reality Keys、Orisi、Bitrated 与 Oraclize 的已记录密钥；同时从归档浏览器和现存 Nostr 中继恢复 DLC 预言机记录。有两点发现。第一，早期合约仍在链上，但许多事件描述已经消失，协议编码与 API 限制也让现存记录更难访问；而对现代 DLC，即使无法在链上识别使用它们的合约，公开的预言机公告仍可能留存。在所考察的脚本类别中，排除铭文数据后，不揭示脚本的花费占比在 2024 年最高达到 81.9%。第二，公开注册表可能误导人们对预言机使用的判断：Counterparty 中 95% 在 2018 年前声明收取预言机费用的源从未被投注；Bitrated 中全部归档密钥只有 0.1% 出现在链上，而 2014 年捕获的 19 个密钥里有 10 个出现过。Counterparty 匹配交易量以体育为主，归档 DLC 公告则以每日价格序列为主。这些发现表明，协议设计与数据保存方式会塑造比特币预言机使用的历史记录。
papers.abstractEn: Before Ethereum made the "oracle problem" a household term, Bitcoin already had oracles serving as feeds, key-release services, federated signers, and arbiters that carried real value on the main chain. This study traces their use and the changing evidence of oracle activity from early days through July 2026. We combine a complete census of Counterparty betting (1,149 bets), analysis of the full Bitcoin chain through block 958,628, and searches for documented keys from Reality Keys, Orisi, Bitrated, and Oraclize in an 854-million-row public-key index. We also recover DLC oracle records from an archived explorer and live Nostr relays. Two results emerge. First, early contracts remain on-chain, but many event descriptions have disappeared, and protocol encoding and API limitations complicate access to the surviving record. However, for modern DLCs, public oracle announcements can survive even when the contracts using them cannot be identified on-chain. In the script classes examined, the share of spends that reveal no script peaks at 81.9% in 2024 after excluding spends containing inscription data. Second, public registries can give a misleading picture of oracle use. In Counterparty, 95% of pre-2018 sources declaring an oracle fee were never bet on. In Bitrated, 0.1% of archived keys appear on-chain overall, compared with 10 of 19 keys captured in 2014. Sport dominates Counterparty's matched volume, while a daily price series dominates the archived DLC announcements. These findings show how protocol design and data preservation shape the historical record of Bitcoin oracle use.
